name: Gold Diary
summary: See where your gold comes from and where it goes, by source, for your session, the day and the week.
logoPrompt: An open leather-bound diary lying at an angle, its pages glowing softly, with a small stack of shiny gold coins resting on the lower corner and one coin standing upright

cover.tagline: Know what your play session was worth.
bullets: Gold earned and spent, by source
Session, today and the last 7 days

description: **Gold Diary keeps a simple diary of your gold: every change is noted with its source, so you see what a session was worth and what eats your money.**
- Sorts every gold change by source: loot, quests, vendor, repairs, Auction House, mail, trainer, flight paths, trade, barber and transmog.
- Three views: this session, today and the last 7 days, each with earned, spent and net gold.
- Net gold per hour for the current session.
- Gold moved to or from the Warband bank or a guild bank is listed on its own and never counts as earned or spent.
Type `/gd` (or `/golddiary`) to open or close the diary. `/gd reset` starts a new session. Escape closes the window.
- Works on Retail. No combat data and no chat parsing, so it behaves the same inside and outside of instances.
- A change is sorted by the window that is open at that moment. What it cannot explain is listed as Other.
- It records only while you are logged in. History is kept for 60 days.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
